cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Up for Debate
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm inspecting the costume cupboard. Unlock it, please, and keep the velvet separate from the other fabric.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That badge is cardboard. Who sent you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the moth damage you reported. Which shelf? We inspect the affected stock first, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring the wardrobe manager. She'll want to know who authorised this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her I'm helping locate the moths. Lead with the damaged shelf, please, not my job title.
